modules.name: Dual Universal Slope Generator
modules.description: Two slope generators: envelope, LFO, oscillator, slew, divider, follower.

modules.name: Smooth & Stepped Generator
modules.description: Slew limiter with hold, sample-and-hold with slew limiting, and a coupler comparator.

modules.name: New Timbral Oscillator
modules.description: VCO with saw, triangle, sine and variable outputs, linear FM, sync and portamento.

modules.name: Wave Multipliers
modules.description: Three waveshapers: VCA or squarer, odd-harmonic folder, even-harmonic rectifiers.

modules.name: Variable Q VCF
modules.description: State-variable filter with voltage-controlled Q, AGC input and trigger ringing.

modules.name: Variable Slope VCF
modules.description: State-variable filter whose slope runs from 6 dB/oct to resonant.

modules.name: Resonant Equalizer
modules.description: Ten fixed bands spaced at major sevenths, with two comb outputs.

modules.name: Triple Waveshaper
modules.description: Three shapers that turn a sawtooth into a sine.

modules.name: Ring Modulator
modules.description: Ring modulator with a dry-to-AM-to-ring control and carrier shaping.

modules.name: Noise Source
modules.description: White, pink and S/H source noise.

modules.name: Dual Schmitt Trigger
modules.description: Two Schmitt triggers and a set-reset flip-flop.

modules.name: Dual Processor
modules.description: Two three-input attenuverting mixers with offset.

modules.name: Dual Channel Stereo Mixer
modules.description: Two voltage-controlled stereo channels with opposite pan CV.

modules.name: Peak & Trough
modules.description: Higher and lower of two voltages.
